placements.why: This envelope's content — a formalized onboarding checklist governing new-hire ramp — is an internal organizational process, not an opportunity, strategy, product, or architecture concern. No strata exists yet in this repo, and nothing supplied is close enough to extend; this names the organizational-process category outright.
placements.title: Internal operating structure as its own governed category
placements.frame: Does this content describe how the org runs itself (roles, processes, onboarding, internal systems) rather than what it sells or how it's built?

placements.title: Onboarding shifts from passive documentation to an active, structured ritual
placements.frame: What concrete step, artifact, or rotation gets added to (or removed from) the first-week checklist, and what does that change reveal about what the org now treats as essential to instill on day one?
placements.why: Src-1 names a recurring, mandatory first-week structure (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) that future envelopes will keep feeding as the checklist evolves — this is a subject, not a one-time fact, so it clears the narrative grain test. Src-2 ('It replaced the old wiki page last quarter') is a fact about that same subject's evolution — evidence of the checklist supplanting a prior, passive onboarding mode — and belongs as support under this leaf rather than as its own leaf, per the narrative-grain rule against minting facts.
